title: Lie or Lay? Rise, Raise or Arise?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to happen; to come up (problems, questions)
vocabulary.example: A few problems have arisen since I started the project.
Something came up, so I can't come tonight.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to go up or get higher by itself; to stand up
vocabulary.example: The sun rises in the east.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to make something higher; to bring up children
vocabulary.example: Raise your hand if you have a question.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an increase in pay (US); UK: a pay rise
vocabulary.note_ar: بالأمريكية a raise وبالبريطانية a pay rise
vocabulary.note_en: US: a raise; UK: a pay rise.
vocabulary.example: I got a raise at work.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to put your body in a flat position (no object)
vocabulary.note_ar: فعل شاذ: lie – lay – lain، والمستمر lying
vocabulary.example: I'm tired. I'm going to lie down.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to put or place something down (needs an object)
vocabulary.example: Please lay the book on the table.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to say something that is not true; a false statement
vocabulary.note_ar: بهذا المعنى فعل منتظم: lie – lied – lied
vocabulary.note_en: In this meaning it's regular: lie – lied – lied.
vocabulary.example: Don't lie to me. / He told me a lie.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to lean back or lie in a flat position
a verb that needs a direct object (lay something, raise something)
a verb that does not take a direct object (lie, rise, arise)
a verb that doesn't add -ed in the past (rise – rose)
to raise and care for children until they are adults

fine_lines.title: rise vs raise
fine_lines.explanation_ar: rise: الشيء يرتفع بنفسه، فعل لازم بلا مفعول (The sun rises). raise: شخص يرفع شيئًا آخر، فعل متعدٍّ يحتاج مفعولًا (They raised the price).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Rise: something goes up by itself; intransitive, no object (The sun rises). Raise: someone makes something else go up; transitive, needs an object (They raised the price).

fine_lines.title: lie vs lay
fine_lines.explanation_ar: lie (lay – lain): تستلقي أنت بنفسك، بلا مفعول. lay (laid – laid): تضع شيئًا، يحتاج مفعولًا. انتبه: lay هي أيضًا ماضي lie!
fine_lines.explanation_en: Lie (lay – lain): you put yourself flat; no object. Lay (laid – laid): you put something down; needs an object. Careful: lay is also the past of lie!

examples.sentence: I lie on the bed. / Yesterday he lay on the bed for hours.
I lay my coat on the bed. / They laid the blanket on the floor.

fine_lines.title: arise vs rise
fine_lines.explanation_ar: arise = يحدث أو يطرأ (مشكلة، سؤال). rise = يرتفع أو ينهض.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Arise = happen, come up (a problem, a question). Rise = go up or stand up.

examples.sentence: Some questions arose in the meeting.
Please rise when the judge enters.

fine_lines.title: lie (recline) vs lie (not true)
fine_lines.explanation_ar: lie لها معنيان: يستلقي (lay – lain) ويكذب (lied – lied). السياق يوضح المعنى.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Lie has two meanings: recline (lay – lain) and say something untrue (lied – lied). Context tells you which.

examples.sentence: You look tired. Go and lie down.
You lied to me. You told me a lie.

expressions.meaning_en: Put your hand up (to ask a question).
expressions.example: Please raise your hand if you have a question.
Sorry, something came up and I can't come.

expressions.meaning_en: I'm going to rest in a flat position.
expressions.example: I have a headache. I'm going to lie down.
Good news! I got a raise at work.

expressions.meaning_en: That makes people want to ask questions.
expressions.example: He said nothing about the money. That raises a few questions.

grammar.title: Transitive vs intransitive
grammar.explanation_ar: الفعل المتعدّي يحتاج مفعولًا به (raise something, lay something). الفعل اللازم لا يأخذ مفعولًا (rise, lie, arise).
grammar.explanation_en: A transitive verb needs a direct object (raise something, lay something). An intransitive verb takes no object (rise, lie, arise).
examples: She raised her hand. (object: her hand)
He laid the pen on the desk. (object: the pen)
He lay on the bed. (no object)

grammar.title: Verb forms to remember
grammar.explanation_ar: arise – arose – arisen. rise – rose – risen. raise – raised – raised (منتظم). lie (يستلقي) – lay – lain. lay (يضع) – laid – laid. lie (يكذب) – lied – lied.
grammar.explanation_en: arise – arose – arisen. rise – rose – risen. raise – raised – raised (regular). lie (recline) – lay – lain. lay (put) – laid – laid. lie (not true) – lied – lied.
examples: She lay down for an hour.
She laid the baby in the bed.

grammar.title: Raise: noun and verb
grammar.explanation_ar: raise كفعل = يرفع. a raise (مع أداة) اسم = زيادة في الراتب (بالأمريكية). الأداة a تساعدك على المعرفة.
grammar.explanation_en: Raise as a verb = make higher. A raise (with an article) is a noun = more pay (US English). The article a helps you know.
